Do the suits dance with your own cast

Four characters, one empty room, thirteen seconds. The video gives only the motion and the expressions. Faces, hair and costumes come from your reference images. Play the clip and the beat list follows along. Tap a beat to jump to it.

    Make it with SYNTX.AI and Seedance 2.5

    SYNTX.AI gives you Seedance 2.5 under one subscription. Omni Reference mode accepts up to 50 references, so the trend video, four characters and the location all fit in one generation, and a 30-second ceiling covers this 13-second clip.

    1. Open SYNTX.AI and start a new video generation.
    2. Under Model selection, choose Seedance and version 2.5.
    3. Under Quality, set Mode to Omni Reference and Resolution to 720p.
    4. Upload the trend video as the motion reference, then Images 1 to 5 in order.
    5. Paste the motion-capture prompt below, set the length to 13 seconds and 9:16, and generate.

    What you need

    Use original, fictional or properly licensed characters. Do not use likenesses of real people.

    Image 1: P1

    Opening walker. Walks in from the back, returns at about 6 s.

    Image 2: P2

    Starts cropped at the left edge, joins at about 3 s, takes center at about 6 s.

    Image 3: P3

    Enters the right foreground at about 1.7 s, pointing. Takes center at about 8 s.

    Image 4: P4

    Swings in from the left at about 1.5 to 2 s and leans into the lens.

    Image 5: location

    Empty 9:16 room with a long clear lane from the back to the camera.

    Character image prompt

    Fill the brackets and generate one image per slot, all in the same style.

    Photoreal full-body character reference, front view, standing relaxed, plain mid-grey seamless background, soft even studio light, sharp focus.
Character: [NAME], [AGE], [FACE SHAPE AND KEY FEATURES].
Hair: [STYLE AND COLOUR]. Facial hair: [NONE / TYPE].
Outfit: [FULL COSTUME, COLOURS, FABRICS, ACCESSORIES].
Expression: [NEUTRAL / SMIRK / DEADPAN].
Natural skin texture, accurate proportions, no text, no logos.

    Location image prompt

    Vertical 9:16 photograph, eye level, slight wide lens, of [LOCATION TYPE], completely empty, no people, no furniture in the centre of the frame.
[FLOOR MATERIAL AND FINISH] floor with soft reflections, [KEY ARCHITECTURE], [WINDOWS AND VIEW], [LIGHT: time of day, direction, colour].
Large clear floor area in the centre and foreground so four people can dance and walk toward the camera from the far end of the room.
Photoreal, sharp, no text, no logos.

    Motion-capture prompt

    Attach the trend video as the motion driver, Images 1 to 4 as characters and Image 5 as the background. Paste the whole block.

    MOTION DRIVER: attached video, used ONLY for body motion, timing and facial expression. Do NOT copy any face, hair, facial hair, body shape, costume, accessories, background or identity from the video.
IDENTITY: face, hair, facial hair, skin, body proportions and full costume for each person come ONLY from that slot's reference image: P1=@Image1, P2=@Image2, P3=@Image3, P4=@Image4. No blending between characters. No duplicates. Exactly 4 people in total.
BACKGROUND: replace the video's room entirely with @Image5, keeping its layout, materials, light direction and view exactly.
CAMERA: locked 9:16 front camera, eye level, slight wide lens, mild handheld micro-sway, no cuts, no zooms. Soft contact shadows and faint reflections on the floor.

1. 0.0-1.5s: P1 walks straight toward camera from the far back of the room, loose confident stride, arms swinging, head level, eyes on lens, growing from small to mid-distance. P2 stands cropped at the left edge, nearly still.
2. 1.5-2.0s: P4 sweeps into the left foreground in one side-step, body angled, arm swinging in. P3 enters the right foreground a beat later, right hand pointing at chest height.
3. 2.0-3.0s: P4 leans toward the lens, head tilted, smirk, raised brows, eyes locked on camera. P3 in front with hands crossed at the chest, small bounce. P1 stays small in the background, still walking, hidden behind them by about 3.0s.
4. 3.0-4.0s: P4 steps to center-left, shoulders loose, hands from chest down to pockets, easy knee bounce. P3 right, chest-height hand flicks. P2 steps in behind and joins the bounce.
5. 4.0-5.0s: Group bounce. P4 center: wide stance, weight shifts L-R every half-beat, one heel kick out to the side, thumbs tugging lapels, chin forward, pursed lips. P2 and P3 flank, mirroring a half-beat late.
6. 5.0-6.0s: Alternating fist pumps. P4 and P2 pump fists overhead one arm at a time while bouncing. P2 steps forward to center as P4 slips right.
7. 6.0-7.0s: P2 center: big knee dips, forearms rolling at the waist, excited open-mouth expression. P1 reappears at front-left with an "O" mouth, elbows tucked, fists at the chest.
8. 7.0-8.0s: P1 front-left: hands tucked at the chest, elbows in, small bounce, wide "O" lips. P2 steps toward center-right and raises one arm, finger pointing up.
9. 8.0-11.0s: P3 takes center: forearms rolling at the waist, hips sway side to side, deadpan face. P1 and P4 flank, bouncing off-beat, lapel flicks and brief hand-to-head hits. Jacket-open shrug at the end of this block.
10. 11.0-13.0s: All keep a loose bounce with exaggerated surprised mouths. Final pose at 12.5s: P3 throws both arms wide, palms down, leaning forward, head tilted. The others sweep arms out in unison, then freeze for the last 6 frames.

LOCKS: expressions copied beat by beat from the video; faces and costumes never altered from the references; natural cloth movement; same choreography and beat timing; no new moves; no text, captions or logos.

    If something goes wrong

    ProblemAdd this line
    A fifth person appearsExactly 4 people in total, no extra background people.
    P1 vanishes while hiddenP1 remains visible small behind the group, only occluded by P3 and P4.
    Walk feels slow in a big roomWalk covers the same screen growth in 2 seconds.
    Video’s outfit or face leaks inIgnore the motion video’s appearance completely; use reference images only.
    Feet slide or reflections breakFeet make correct contact with the floor; reflections follow the feet accurately.
